requirement: When `output.html.git-repository-url` names a GitHub repository and `output.html.edit-url-template` uses that repository's `/edit/<branch>/{path}` form, each safely resolved source location displayed for an evidence input MUST link its repository-relative file and inclusive line range to `/blob/<branch>/<file>#L<start>-L<end>`. A source location MUST remain plain text when a safe URL cannot be derived. A generated detail page MUST use its evidence JSON file as the mdBook edit target when the file exists, or its requirement chapter when the evidence file is missing.
rationale: I found no gaps. Each obligation has code that carries it out, and each has a test. **Obligations and code** 1. **Link each safely resolved source location to `/blob//#L-L`, when the repository is on GitHub and the template has the `/edit//{path}` form.** - `SourceLinks::from_config` (src/index.rs:46-86) reads `output.html.git-repository-url` and `output.html.edit-url-template`. - It requires an `https://github.com//` repository with a valid owner and project. - It requires the template to be `/edit//{path}`. It returns `None` otherwise, including when the template names a different repository. - It builds `blob_prefix` as `/blob/`. - `SourceLinks::input_url` (88-109) builds `/#L-L`. - `encode_url_segment` percent-encodes each path segment. - `render_input` (821-907) calls `render_source_location` (909-937) for every resolved range. `render_source_location` wraps the location in `` when a URL exists. 2. **Keep the location as plain text when no safe URL can be derived.** - `from_config` returns `None` for a non-GitHub repository, a malformed repository, or a template that does not match the repository. - `input_url` returns `None` for line 0, an end line before the start line, or a path with `..` or absolute components. - `render_source_location` then falls back to a plain `` location. 3. **Use the evidence JSON file as the mdBook edit target when it exists, and the requirement chapter when it is missing.** - `DetailPlan::populate` (355-468) picks `evidence_edit_path(...)` if `evidence_path.exists()`, and `definition.path` otherwise. - It sets that value as the page's `source_path`. - The block in `preprocess_book` (src/lib.rs) that handles chapters with a `source_path` supports this. It keeps these generated detail pages out of definition-chapter processing. **Tests** - `source_links_use_configured_repository_and_branch` (src/index.rs:1417) checks the exact blob URL with line range and a non-default branch. It also checks: - percent-encoding of the file path; - `None` for a `..` path and for start line 0; - `None` for a mismatched-repository template and for a `javascript:` repository; - the rendered `` in a detail page; - `evidence_edit_path`. - `detail_page_renders_markdown_and_highlighted_input_sections` (1329) renders with `source_links: None`. It asserts the plain `src/main.rs:1–4` text. - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` (1070) asserts `source_path` is `../evidence/requirements.core.ready.json` when the evidence file exists. It asserts `requirements/core.md` for the page with no evidence file. I found no unspecified behavior and no unmarked implementing code or tests.
